title: Tooltip
hint: Hover or tab to the i next to Username: it is close to the top edge, so the tooltip appears below. The i next to Password has room above, so the tooltip appears above. The Calculated values show which placement was used.
tweak: In the JavaScript tab, set flip to "none" and the first tooltip leaves the box.

scenarios.name: below the button when the top edge is in the way
above the button when there is room
